body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2007') -- <Visual News> Samsung presented ‘F300’, a new addition of its premium product lineup ‘Ultra slim’ mobile phone series during CES 2007.

The F300, dual-face mobile phone, was revealed for the first time during ITU Telecom World 2006 last year – but just only one side of music phone feature. This time, the company unveiled the whole body with full working mobile phone/music play capabilities.

It has a totally different design on each side with 2.1-inch and 2.3-inch LCD respectively; for the music phone side with bigger screen. It also features microSD card slot and ‘sweeping’ UI that you need to press the button with a quick smooth move to navigate. The internal memory capacity is not decided yet.
It is expected to be available in Korea, Europe and USA market in February or early March, 2007.
